title: Document the engine installer and version contract
summary: The engine repository's README and CHANGELOG describe the one-command engine installer, the launcher and PATH behaviour, uninstall, the machine-readable version, and how the version a configured source or ref provides is obtained and compared.
plan_goal: Make Forgel and Forgel Code install and run as one working pair: give the engine `forgel` its own installer, add a mode of the Forgel Code installer that installs both binaries together (offered by default in the README, idempotent — when the engine is already present it compares versions and installs only a strictly newer one), and introduce a declared minimum supported engine version for Forgel Code, checked at startup, so a missing or too-old engine produces a clear actionable message instead of `engine forgel: executable not found: forgel`.

result.summary: The shipped engine has no installer to document. The plan docs/program/plans/20261124145600_make-forgel-and-forgel-code-install-and-.md marks backlog item 2, 'Add the engine's one-command installer with pre-install version resolution', as blocked ('the dependency scout exceeded its step limit'), and that task's spec (docs/program/specs/20261124152248_add-the-engine-s-one-command-installer-w.md) states 'The owner decides this task's scope before it can be implemented'. In this repository there is no install script (no install.sh anywhere; only deploy/entrypoint.sh and Django template scripts), no uninstall path, no private prefix, no launcher placed on PATH, no marked profile block or shell-reachability handling (no 'export PATH' in the tree), and no determination of the version a configured source or release ref would provide. The only shipped piece is the version inquiry in src/forgel/engine_version.py ('forgel version [--json]', dispatched from src/forgel/entry.py), which alone cannot satisfy FR-1, FR-2, FR-3, FR-5, FR-6, FR-7, AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-5, AC-6, AC-7 and AC-9. Writing the installation, entry point, pre-install version determination, strictly-newer comparison and removal text would document behaviour the shipped installer and engine do not perform, which FR-8, AC-8 and the specification's own Risks section forbid. Decision needed: unblock and implement the engine installer task first, then re-run this documentation task against the shipped behaviour.
